Noctra Air

A PIR motion sensor with a CO2 sensor for meeting rooms. Estimates occupancy from motion and CO2 rise.

Tallyway Beam

A time-of-flight (ToF) doorway counter. Counts people in and out of a room; battery powered.

Up to 7 years of battery life. Install it and forget it.
